name: Larry Williams 3-period EMA of highs vs lows (BTC)
author: DragoLite (from Larry Williams, Long-Term Secrets to Short-Term Trading)
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
indicators: EMA(3) of high, EMA(3) of low
entry_long: Close < EMA(3) of lows -> go long on the confirmed bar.
exit: Close long when close > EMA(3) of highs.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Long-only; no stop in source. Uses security() lookahead_on in helper; implement on bar close.
